hero.title2: is a shipment waiting to happen.
hero.subtitle: Cargozents connects buyers, shippers, and drivers on one network — so a truck heading back empty picks up someone else's load instead. Less wasted diesel, more driver income, faster delivery for everyone.

problem.title: Half the trip is usually wasted.

without.label: WITHOUT CARGOZENTS
without.title: The return trip runs empty.
without.line1: Truck delivers, then drives back with nothing on board.
without.line2: Diesel, tolls, and driver time are spent for zero revenue.
without.line3: The next shipment waits for a truck that was already on the road.

with.label: WITH CARGOZENTS
with.title: The return trip earns.
with.line1: A nearby shipment is matched to the truck’s return route.
with.line2: The driver earns on a leg that used to be a pure cost.
with.line3: The shipper gets a truck that was already headed their way.

step1.title: A load enters the network
step1.body: A buyer orders from a shipper’s catalog, or a shipper posts a shipment directly — goods, weight, pickup, and drop.

step2.title: Cargozents matches the truck
step2.body: The dispatch engine checks nearby drivers already heading that way — especially ones about to run their return leg empty.

step3.title: The driver delivers and gets paid
step3.body: Pickup, live tracking, drop-off, and payout — the driver earns on a leg that used to cost them money.

roles.title: Built for everyone in the chain.

buyer.desc: Order directly from a shipper’s catalog and track delivery to your door.

shipper.desc: Sell products or post one-off shipments — request a truck whenever you need one.

driver.desc: Declare your route and capacity, accept matched loads, get paid per trip.

admin.desc: Verify drivers and vehicles, assign trucks to requests, and monitor the network.

cta.title: Stop paying for empty kilometers.
cta.subtitle: Join as a shipper, driver, or buyer — the network works better the moment you’re on it.
